description: Akenon Studio's shared Renovate preset (design 6.4). Every managed repo's renovate.json extends it with "github>Akenon-Studio/.github". A person approves every update; nothing merges on its own. The schedule is "at any time" only for the first run (#118); #119 puts it back to before 9am on monday (design 6.4).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes open at once, whatever the schedule.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates in one weekly PR per repo, to keep CI minutes down.
three.js is part of the animation contract shared by platform and animations: both move together, by hand (platform#53).
dependency-cruiser 16 supports TypeScript <6, and outside its range it can stop parsing .ts files without failing; a repo stays on TypeScript 5 until it moves to dependency-cruiser 18 (platform#53).
platform is on dependency-cruiser 18, which supports TypeScript <7 (platform#196). Add a repo here when it moves to dependency-cruiser 18.
platform's grouped update, in one lockfile pass, ran out of Mend's 3 GB (.github#123): there each app and package gets its own branch; the root and the workflows stay in one.
